purpose: Prospective validation of richer timestamped bookmaker-market structures after three retrospective frozen universes produced zero promotable patterns.

data_source.opening_definition: earliest retained quote with created_at strictly before kickoff
data_source.closing_definition: latest retained quote with created_at strictly before kickoff
data_source.result_join: exact OddsPapi fixture_id through exact external provider mapping only; no fuzzy team/date matching
data_source.settlement: actual Asian quarter-line settlement; non-quarter lines rejected rather than rounded

universe.collection_policy: collect prospectively as fixtures occur; do not backfill synthetic observation times

prospective_phases.split_rule: split only after the season dataset is complete enough to determine chronological fixture counts; phase boundaries are percentages, not chosen by performance

anti_p_hacking_rule: Do not alter dimensions, buckets, phase split, sample sizes, FDR, CI, CLV, stability, risk, or current-EV gates after inspecting prospective 2026/27 performance. Any change becomes a new hypothesis requiring a later untouched holdout.
production_rule: Only candidates passing every frozen prospective gate and a separate audit may enter reports/pattern_registry.json.
